title: Magnetic reversals

data.source: Geologic Time Scale 2012 polarity boundaries (Gradstein et al.), as listed in PmagPy; reversals younger than 84 million years

prediction: If the core counted toward each flip, the CV of the gaps would be below the 5th percentile for memoryless gaps (P1) and a first-passage density would fit better than a memoryless one (P2). We expected this to fail.
baseline: A memoryless (Poisson) process, the field's standard first description.
why: The gaps between reversals are not more even than a memoryless process gives. There is no sign of a count that has to refill before the next flip. The grammar does not help here, as expected.
